caption:
Soft starts make hard feedback harder. If you sound unsure, they’ll spend the whole talk looking for the real message.

Save this for the next time you’re about to soften it.

#newmanager #firsttimemanager #leadership #managertips #difficultconversations

slides.headline: It makes the feedback sound <u>optional</u>.
slides.sub: Now they can brush it off as your personal style.

slides.label: Say this
slides.quote: “I’ve noticed you cut people off in meetings, and it needs to stop.”

slides.headline: Don’t hide the point.
slides.sub: Say the issue plainly, so you can actually talk about it.

slides.headline: The first time you say it shouldn’t be the real time.
slides.sub: Practice it out loud with Steady.
